At fixed lower binomial index t, the decreasing successive-factor ratio yields strict balancing for t≥1. The balanced t-ratio crosses one at m−1, m−1, a tie at m−1 and m, and m, respectively, giving all and only the stated loop splits. The unequal-endpoint optimizing ratios give the stated comparison factors (4m−1)/(2m−1), 2, (4m+1)/(2m+2), 2, all strictly larger than one for m≥2. Constant words have multiplicity one. Independent bitwise enumeration checks all small maxima and the exact argmax sets at lengths 8–12.
